data.title: 时崎狂三 · 深夜拉面
data.description: 【时崎狂三 · 深夜拉面】深夜街角温暖的拉面摊里，狂三坐在吧台高脚凳上，双手捧着热气腾腾的豚骨拉面大碗，眼神里满是少女般的满足与好奇。她转过脸狡黠地向你眨眨眼——「深夜的平民美食果然有一种难以抗拒的魔力呢……怎么，难道精灵就不能喜欢吃拉面吗？」
data.action: 坐在高脚凳上双手捧住刚端来的拉面碗，转脸眨眼，筷子留在吧台上
data.promptProse: Kurumi cups a newly served ramen bowl in both hands on the tall counter stool, turning to offer the viewer a conspiratorial wink. Unused chopsticks lie horizontally on their holder beside the bowl. Steam curls in front of her black cardigan within the medium view. Warm pendant lamps brighten broth and wood grain, casting the bowl's shadow toward the dark late-night street visible beyond the counter.
